labs.location: Harvard Kennedy School, 79 JFK Street, Cambridge, MA 02138
labs.research_summary: Harvard Kennedy School research group on economic growth and development policy that advises governments on growth strategies and builds public data tools such as the Atlas of Economic Complexity.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 faculty director, 1 executive director, 5 other directors, 2 senior managers of applied research, 3 senior research fellows, 1 senior applied research fellow, 16 research fellows, 5 research managers, 2 postdoctoral fellows, 1 EADM fellow, 1 senior computational social scientist, 1 research analyst, 5 development and design staff, 6 administrative staff
labs.join_notes: The jobs page lists current research and staff openings and says internships are posted there too. It now describes Policy Research Fellowships (deadline December 31, 2026) and a visiting fellows and scholars program for self-funded researchers staying 6 to 12 months. The home page points students to internships and in-semester RA posts. Contact is growthlab@hks.harvard.edu.
labs.notes: Count is the 50 distinct people listed under Senior Leadership, Academic Research, Policy Research, Development & Design and Administration (some names appear in two sections).
